payload.text: /plumb intent I want to improve the mods that gives the plumb user intel on the progress of its plumb intent integration and implementation. Help me draft an update of plumb so that the user gets a nice visualisation of the step of plumb intent workflow we're at, as well as progress bar for in-workflow task progress. Maybe also during that workflow we could have suggestions of studies proposed to the user through the browser, so that when the intent is being validated, integrated, developped, the user can expand his knowledge on what has been built, or what's being built, suggested by the AI with a nice UI notification with nice colors. Make sure also that the colors used by plumb, its visual mod identity is uniquely differenciated and not mis-identified as claude internals
